film.sceneScaleNote: Small low-lit room, roughly 4m x 4m. Narrow wooden table 1.5m long (along Z) by 0.8m wide (along X), height 0.75m. Two chairs at opposite ends. Single hanging bulb above table center.

subjects.subject: <Subject 1>
subjects.action: sits at table facing <Subject 2>, hands resting on tabletop

subjects.subject: <Subject 2>
subjects.action: sits at table facing <Subject 1>, arms folded loosely

beats.containmentNotes: Both subjects seated at opposite ends of the narrow table. No chair objects in cast; groundOffsetM=0 indicates seated posture with implied seat height ~0.45m.
beats.proseNote: Live-action, cinematic, a medium-wide shot frames the two figures across the table from the audience side. The camera sits at positive Z looking toward -Z, holding a steady wide two-shot. <Subject 1> in neon yellow tracksuit occupies the left of frame, <Subject 2> in green moto jacket the right. The single hanging bulb casts a warm pool of light over the tabletop; bare walls fall into shadow beyond. No camera movement.

subjects.subject: <Subject 1>
subjects.action: sits facing <Subject 2>, subtle shift of weight

subjects.subject: <Subject 2>
subjects.action: sits facing <Subject 1>, glances down at table

beats.containmentNotes: Positions unchanged from beat 1. Camera has pushed in from 3m to 1.5m, tightening the two-shot to a medium shot on <Subject 1>.
beats.proseNote: From the same side of the table, the camera pushes in with medium amplitude at medium speed, shortening the distance from three metres to one and a half while the focal length shifts to 35mm. The wide two-shot becomes a medium shot that favours <Subject 1> on the left, the neon tracksuit and heart-shaped sunglasses now legible. <Subject 2> on the right remains in the frame but smaller. The bulb's glow sharpens on the wood grain.

subjects.subject: <Subject 1>
subjects.action: sits facing <Subject 2>, now seen from behind near shoulder

subjects.subject: <Subject 2>
subjects.action: sits facing camera, pink buzz-cut and orange glasses catch the light

beats.containmentNotes: Camera has crossed the 180-degree line, moving from the audience side (+Z) to the far side of the table (-Z) behind <Subject 1>. Subjects swap frame sides: <Subject 1> now left foreground (shoulder), <Subject 2> right midground.
beats.proseNote: The camera executes a large-amplitude arc shot at medium speed, swinging from the audience side around the near end of the table to a position behind <Subject 1>'s right shoulder. It settles at 50mm, framing a close-up of <Subject 2> across the table — pink buzz-cut, orange translucent glasses, green patent leather jacket vivid in the bulb light. <Subject 1>'s neon yellow tracksuit shoulder anchors the left foreground. The move crosses the line, so the figures exchange screen sides.

subjects.subject: <Subject 1>
subjects.action: sits, shoulder and back of head visible in lower left

subjects.subject: <Subject 2>
subjects.action: sits, face tilts down following camera to table

beats.containmentNotes: Camera position fixed; only the look-at point drops from <Subject 2>'s face to the table center. <Subject 1> remains seated at near end, <Subject 2> at far end.
beats.proseNote: Holding the same position behind <Subject 1>'s shoulder, the camera tilts down with medium amplitude at slow speed, the look-at point falling from <Subject 2>'s face to the tabletop midway between them. The wood grain, a few scattered objects, and the edge of the bulb's light pool fill the frame. <Subject 2>'s chin and glasses slip toward the top of frame; <Subject 1>'s shoulder remains a dark shape at bottom left.

subjects.subject: <Subject 1>
subjects.action: stands, walks around the table's near end, crosses behind <Subject 2>, stops standing behind them

subjects.subject: <Subject 2>
subjects.action: remains seated, turns head slightly to track <Subject 1>'s movement

beats.containmentNotes: <Subject 1> rises from seated to standing (groundOffsetM remains 0 as no chair object exists), walks a curved path around the table's near end (z > 0) then behind <Subject 2> to z = -1.8. <Subject 2> stays seated throughout.
beats.proseNote: The camera does not move, holding its tilted-down angle on the table. <Subject 1> stands — the neon yellow tracksuit rising into view at frame left — and walks with deliberate steps around the table's near end, crossing behind <Subject 2> to stop standing directly behind them at the far side. <Subject 2> turns their head to follow the movement. The bulb light catches the white sneakers and yellow hat as <Subject 1> passes through the pool of light.
